cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CES769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam. You are parking at Stand 223. You have received information C, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方769，一架从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹的飞机。你现在停在223号停机位，你已经收到通播C，请求管制放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, stand 223, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方769，223号停机位，通播C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 36, initial climb to 1800m, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 11000m, squawk 6127.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道36，初始爬升至1800米，HZ-01离场，巡航高度11000米，应答机6127。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 36, initial climb to 1800m, HZ01 departure, cruising level 11000m, squawk 6127, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道36，初始爬升至1800米，HZ-01离场，巡航高度11000米，应答机6127，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Two passengers are quarreling loudly in the cabin, and the air security are needed to remove the passengers away, report it to Wuhan Delivery, and request to delay the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 两名乘客在客舱大吵起来，需要安保人员将他们送下飞机。将情况报告给武汉放行，请求推迟航班。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, two passengers are quarreling loudly in the cabin, we need air security to remove the passengers, and request to delay the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方769，两名乘客在客舱大吵起来，我们需要安保人员将他们送下飞机，请求推迟航班。

cards.audioText: B: [Now the passengers have been removed by the airport security. You are ready to copy ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在乘客已经被安保人员送下飞机，你准备好抄收放行许可了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, we are fully ready to copy ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方769，我们准备好抄收管制许可了。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, re-cleared to Amsterdam, initial climb to 1200m, HZ-02 departure, squawk 5101, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，重新许可至阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至1200米，HZ-02离场，应答机5101，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Re-cleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 1200m, HZ-02 departure, squawk 5101, the rest unchanged, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可至阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至1200米，HZ-02离场，应答机5101，其余不变，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are holding at holding point runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在跑道36的外等待点等待，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, holding at holding point of runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方769，在跑道36的外等待点等待。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, expedite cross runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，加速穿越跑道36，经由滑行道Z5，A4和A滑行。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速穿越跑道36，经由滑行道Z5，A4和A滑行，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are ready for departure.]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方769，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，上跑道，可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 36, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道，可以立即起飞，跑道36，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, passing 600m for 1200m, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已经离地，正在过600米飞往1200米，联系武汉离场请求进一步爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, airborne, passing 600m for 1200m, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，离地了，过600米，飞往1200米，请求进一步爬升。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, radar contact, climb to 3000m on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，雷达识别，爬升至3000米，修压1012。

cards.audioText: B: [During climb, your instrument shows that cabin temperature is too high, report it to the controller and ask to level off to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你的仪表显示客舱温度过高，将此报告给管制员，请求平飞并执行检查单。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, cabin temperature is too high, request level off to perform the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，客舱温度过高，请求平飞并执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, climb and maintain 2400m, when able, say your intention.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，上到2400米保持，可以的时候，告知意图。

cards.audioText: B: [After performing the checklist, you decide to dump fuel and return for landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 当执行完检查单，你决定放油并返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, request dump fuel and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，请求放油并返场着陆。
